name: ctp-core-iorn-001-measurement
scope: The measurement module ctp_measure.py, the dataset-access module unitobrain.py, the six drivers that produce every number in paper/results/, and their tests. Pure computation over NumPy arrays and scalars, plus DICOM reading in unitobrain.py. No network access, no GUI, no patient data and no clinical claim. The UniToBrain data these run on are public, de-identified and openly licensed; none of it is included here, and no local path is included either: unitobrain.py takes the dataset's location from the UNITOBRAIN_ROOT environment variable and has no default, which a test enforces for every file in the snapshot. Out of scope and deliberately not sent: the ctp_core package itself (its own suite is pytest-style, which this cross-check v1 cannot run), figure rendering, and the manuscript.
requirements:
These files produce the numbers a manuscript will report, so each must hold exactly the property it is relied on for.

ctp_measure.py. (1) sampled_peak_time returns the argmax of a sampled curve and therefore only ever a value present in the given time axis; mismatched or empty inputs raise ValueError. (2) fitted_peak_time implements a validity rule: a fitted peak time is admitted only when the fit succeeded, the value is finite, and it lies within the closed acquisition window; otherwise it returns no value together with the reason. This rule exists because the curve fitter it guards reports success for peak times far outside the acquisition -- -32 s and +919 s were observed on a 0-44 s acquisition -- and admitting those moved a hemispheric mean from +0.24 s to +17.9 s. (3) quantisation_floor returns dt/sqrt(12), the standard deviation of a value rounded to a grid of spacing dt, and rejects a non-positive dt. (4) curve_area integrates only the positive part of an enhancement curve. (5) cbv_from_areas returns tissue area over arterial area scaled for density, so that an arterial area understated by a factor k inflates CBV by exactly k; a non-positive arterial area raises. The measured median k over 15 public cases was 6.97. (6) hemispheres splits a 2-D mask at the column centroid of the mask, not at the image centre, and the two parts must be disjoint and together cover the mask; an empty mask raises.

unitobrain.py. (7) load() must refuse a ragged volume rather than silently stacking one, and must refuse a case whose time vector, arterial input and number of acquisitions disagree. (8) tissue_mask admits a voxel only when its baseline attenuation is plausible and a bolus actually arrived; busiest_slice returns the slice with the most such voxels. (9) root() must be redirectable by UNITOBRAIN_ROOT, because the dataset is not redistributed with the repository.

The drivers. (10) run_screen.py chooses the figure case by a rule frozen before it was run -- largest absolute left-right median TTP difference in the dataset's own reference maps -- and aborts rather than ranking a partially extracted set. The median, not the mean, is deliberate; so is taking the midline from the mask. (11) run_clinical.py draws a fixed number of voxels per hemisphere with a fixed seed, and must draw them once per case so that the two input series and the two methods are compared on the same voxels; its precision is not asserted but measured: the standard error of each hemispheric difference is computed from the two recorded spreads, with the finite-population correction for a draw without replacement, and stored per arm as delta_standard_error. An earlier docstring claimed 0.05 s against an effect of about 5 s; both numbers were wrong and the claim is withdrawn. (12) run_synthetic.py jitters bolus arrival across one sampling interval, because an arrival always landing on a sampling instant would make the fit-free path unbiased by construction and the whole comparison vacuous. (13) run_aif.py and run_reference.py must save enough to recompute what they report. (14) run_propagation.py must straddle the point at which the implementation's clips make an arterial error invisible in the maps.

Please look for ways any of these could be wrong or could degrade silently, including numerical edge cases, floating-point behaviour, and any place where a driver's result would change without a test going red. Say plainly where a test asserts less than the requirement it claims to cover. prove_driver_gates.py demonstrates the tests by injection: it applies each defect to a copy and requires the test named for it to go red. Run it rather than trusting a count in this prose -- a count here went stale once already. It distinguishes a failed assertion from an escaped exception, and refuses a mutation whose expected test name is ambiguous. If any injection could pass for the wrong reason, say so.

What the previous round of this cross-check found, and what was done about it. Every finding below was a real defect; please check the fix rather than take it on trust, and say if any of them is now wrong in a new way. (15) run_screen aborted on the number of case directories, so empty reference folders were skipped and a figure case was still chosen; it now aborts unless every case produced a comparison. (16) run_clinical applied the filtered series' time axis, window and slice index to the unfiltered series without checking they correspond; it now verifies shape and slice locations. (17) reference_map ordered slices by file name while the volume ordered them by slice location, and the volume's index was used to index the reference; reference_map now orders by location and at_slice refuses an index whose position disagrees with the volume's, which run_reference passes from the recorded slice_location. (18) _read_series let two files sharing an acquisition number and slice location silently overwrite one another; it now raises. (19) run_reference wrote an 'all cases' stratum pooling the two sampling intervals, directly against amendment 5 of paper/PROTOCOL.md; there is no pooled row now. (20) the screen and the reference comparison had drifted to different total-voxel minimums while a test called them identical; the reference now derives its thresholds from the screen's. (21) run_aif had no case-count gate, so exclusions silently shrank the population behind the median it reports; it now aborts unless 15 cases, 15 measurements and 15 finite ratios all agree. The voxel draw in run_clinical and the arrival jitter in run_synthetic were inline and untested, and are now functions with tests. prove_driver_gates.py reports a failure and a raised exception differently, and does not claim the named test is the only one that may fail.

The third round found seven more, all real, and they are fixed; please check the fixes rather than trust them. (22) run_propagation took either map clipping as both saturating, though CBF comes from a deconvolution and CBV from a ratio of areas and nothing obliges them to reach their ceilings together; the two are now judged and reported separately. (23) _read_series sorted the acquisition numbers and discarded them, so a series with an acquisition missing from the middle could be stacked into a shorter but well-formed volume and handed the dataset's full time axis; they must now be contiguous, they are carried on the Acquisition, and run_clinical compares them between the two series -- equal shapes and equal slice locations do not establish temporal correspondence. (24) at_slice accepted a non-finite slice position, because NaN compares false against everything and so passed the tolerance test that was supposed to catch a mismatch. (25) run_reference's completeness gate compared the result against whatever f1_f2_clinical.json held, so the documented plumbing check run_clinical.py --cases 1 would have silently replaced the 15-case result with a one-case one; it now gates on the published 15. (26) its two strata were selected with dt < 1.0 and dt > 1.0, so a case at exactly the boundary or at NaN belonged to neither and was dropped from every summary while still being counted; stratum_of now assigns exactly one and refuses a non-finite interval. (27) the ctp_measure docstring claimed the drivers hold no arithmetic of their own, which was false and is corrected. (28) every driver rebound sys.stdout to a TextIOWrapper over sys.stdout.buffer, which raises when stdout has no buffer, so no driver's main() could be called from a test and none of the round-one gates was covered end to end; that is now driver_io.use_utf8_stdout, and run_screen.main and run_reference.main are exercised against a replaced dataset. run_clinical.main is covered end to end by ClinicalEndToEnd against a replaced dataset, but that class is skipped where ctp_core cannot be imported -- which includes this snapshot, since ctp_core is out of scope here. So those checks have no executable coverage inside this manifest, and the skip is visible in the report rather than looking green. They do run in the repository and in CI, and prove_driver_gates.py puts the repository on PYTHONPATH so its injections exercise them. run_aif.main is not covered end to end at all.

The fifth round found four more. (34) The screen's new completeness check failed open: expected_slices returned None when the acquisition folder or the time file was missing, and main() then skipped the check -- although that is itself the partial-extraction situation the check was added for. Not knowing is now an exclusion, and each way of failing to derive the count says which it was. One limitation remains and is stated in the docstring: a partly extracted acquisition folder whose file count happens to divide by the number of time points still yields a wrong expected count. (35) A test still asserted the precision claim the driver had withdrawn, computing 1/sqrt(500) against an assumed 1 s spread; it is deleted, and the injection that named it as its oracle now names the test that pins the frozen count. (36) The draw is without replacement from a finite hemisphere, so the variance of each mean carries the factor (1 - n/N); it was missing, and subtracting an inflated variance from the disagreement with the reference maps would erase genuine disagreement. With 500 of about 35,000 the factor is 0.986, so the published conclusions do not change, but the quantity being subtracted is now an estimate of the right thing. The fitted path's rejections make n the admitted count rather than the drawn count, which makes the formula approximate on that path; that is stated in the function. (37) The documented plumbing check run_clinical.py --cases 1 still overwrote the published 15-case result, which takes an hour to recompute; a partial run now writes f1_f2_clinical.partial.json. Finally, the injection proof now reports how many defects were caught by the named test's own assertion and how many only because the defect made the code raise, and the freshness-check injection was replaced with one that fails open -- reading the stale field with .get -- so that its assertion has to do the work.
